projection.name: kafka
projection.title: Kafka
projection.description: Kafka cluster browser with brokers, topics, partitions, recent messages, consumer groups, offsets, and producers.

fields.label: Bootstrap brokers
fields.help: One or more host:port brokers, comma-separated.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks produce, create, delete, and offset changes.

fields.label: Config key
fields.help: Topic-level config name, e.g. retention.ms or cleanup.policy.

actions.label: Add partitions
actions.confirmText: Add partitions? Increasing partitions is irreversible and can change key-to-partition routing.

fields.label: New partition count
fields.help: Total partitions after the increase. Must be greater than the current count; partitions can only be added, never removed.

fields.label: Reset to
fields.help: Move every committed partition of this group to the start or end of the log. The group must have no active members.
